content: Client-side search libs: FlexSearch = fastest, best for 100k+ docs, worker support, but heavier API. MiniSearch = modern, well-maintained, fuzzy + field boosting + filtering + field-scoped relevance, lightweight, query times near FlexSearch, excellent browser perf — best balance for thousands of records and field-scoped UI search. Fuse.js = best typo tolerance/fuzzy but slow at scale (no inverted index). For field-scoped fuzzy people-search at dozens-to-thousands scale, MiniSearch is the recommendation (per-field indexing supports the per-field checkbox toggle feature).
